mainEntity.name: Where Is TRF Industrial Automation Located, and Which Regions Does It Serve?

acceptedAnswer.text: TRF Industrial Automation is based in Lenexa, Kansas, and serves manufacturers across the United States. Field service technicians are centralized at the Lenexa base and travel from there when a visit is needed. See locations and coverage for how plants in every region are supported, and the contact page for address and phone.

mainEntity.name: Can One Automation Partner Supply Palletizing, Case Packing and Conveyors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. TRF supplies case packing, conveying and robotic palletizing as one engineered end-of-line system: one project, one engineering team and one partner for the scope TRF delivers. A plant can also start with a single platform, such as a TRFCobot on one line, and add a case packer and conveyors later with the same partner.

mainEntity.name: What Do I Need to Start an End-of-Line Automation Project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bring your product and package dimensions, line rate, pallet pattern, shifts and the floor space at the end of the line. A Sales Engineer starts with your application, not a catalog, and helps you find the right platform. To size the investment first, the palletizing ROI calculator gives a payback estimate for planning.
